title: Signature 49 · USSBBW · Najeon · Bamboo Dawn
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her mid 40s, silver-streaked low bun with a mother-of-pearl binyeo.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely inlaid with thick cut mother-of-pearl shell pieces with visible sharp cut edges, flashing pink, green, and blue iridescent sheen, not painted, real inlaid shell. Large peony blossoms and continuous vines cover the whole body, a line of mother-of-pearl shell running along each belly roll, darker lacquer settling into each deep crease. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal with her feet planted far apart, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, never covering the belly, so every roll is fully visible.

Footwear: Extremely high black lacquer platform stiletto mules with mother-of-pearl studs. Nails: extra long stiletto, black with pearl tips.

Background & Lighting: A pale misty bamboo grove at dawn, soft white light filtering through tall green stalks, the background much lighter than her body, low sunlight carving deep shadows between each belly roll, making every shell piece flash rainbow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
